US-REG-001.title: User registration
acceptance_criteria: Valid registration creates an account and opens the workspace.
Name is required and must contain at least 2 characters.
Email is required and must be valid.
Duplicate email cannot be registered.
Password must contain at least 6 characters, one number and one special character.
Password confirmation must match.
Terms must be accepted.

US-LOGIN-001.title: User login
acceptance_criteria: Registered user can sign in with correct credentials.
Invalid credentials show an error.
Email and password are required.

US-TASK-001.title: Create task
acceptance_criteria: Logged-in user can create a task with a title.
Task title is required.
User can set description, priority, status and due date.
Created task appears in the list.

US-TASK-002.title: Edit task
acceptance_criteria: Logged-in user can edit an existing task.
Saved changes are visible in the task list.

US-TASK-003.title: Complete task
acceptance_criteria: User can mark a task as completed.
User can reopen a completed task.

US-TASK-004.title: Delete task
acceptance_criteria: Delete action asks for confirmation.
Confirmed deletion removes the task.

US-TASK-005.title: Filter and search tasks
acceptance_criteria: User can search tasks by title or description.
User can filter by priority.
User can filter by status.
User can sort tasks.
